description: Paste 192.168.1.10/24 or any IPv4 CIDR to get the network, broadcast, usable host range, subnet and wildcard masks in binary – then split it into equal subnets. Web page: https://calcbright.com/ip-subnet-calculator

ip.description: IPv4 address You can also type CIDR notation, such as 10.0.0.0/16.

split.description: Split into subnets (optional) Rounded up to a power of two – e.g. 4 subnets of a /24 are four /26 networks.

name: ip_subnet_calculator
title: IP Subnet Calculator
